title: Replicate voice variability in Parkinson screening: source-cohort improvement fails external transfer
abstract: Between-phonation dispersion of log jitter and log shimmer improved source-only leave-one-identifier-out prediction but did not demonstrate transfer to an independent 80-person voice dataset: Brier loss changed by 0.02162 (joint bootstrap 95% interval -0.03293 to 0.07897).
